listing.name: Point Blank (Point Blank PC Port)
listing.summary: Attach an independently permitted, prepared Point Blank PlayStation Windows player with your own USA SLUS-00481 CUE/BIN. The current package contains the native player; lightgun hardware, arcade originals and earlier builder packages retain separate scope.

steps.title: Prepare the exact PlayStation original upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete player/components you are independently permitted to use, with your own Point Blank PlayStation USA SLUS-00481 CUE and all referenced BIN tracks. The selected profile pins data Track 01 to 297,657,360 bytes and SHA1 367a96937bfbe19ce5089c0b364f513cbe07dd1e; boot executable is SLUS_004.81. A track digest is not a whole-CUE/container signature or permission to obtain the original. Arcade Point Blank and other regions are different sources. Finish Browse For Disc verification, optional Install To Game Folder and settings upstream.

steps.title: Keep the native player package
steps.instruction: The inspected official 1.1.0 Windows x64 ZIP contains AMD64 PointBlank_Recompiled.exe, its matching libraries/resources, OpenBIOS and notices. It differs from the earlier 1.0.0 builder package. Use the complete folder; no Sony BIOS is needed for the bundled OpenBIOS route. Exact framework pins are psxrecomp a916ed52e00f364a8615b97cd597858aa7f385dc and recomp-ui 47efe197de035685dafad5331a1d56ec7c07c304. No original, BIOS, converter, compiler, helper or game is obtained or executed by this guide.

steps.title: Attach the prepared direct player
steps.instruction: Select PointBlank_Recompiled.exe, use the complete extracted PointBlank-PC-Port-v1.1.0-windows-x64 folder as working directory and set the documented --no-launcher argument. Review the intent and request Play separately. The integrated launcher and native runtime share the selected process; complete any disc/BIOS/setup prompt upstream first. Do not select an original PS-X executable or an obsolete build wrapper. The runtime reads the remembered source/configuration; keep installed disc files and any external originals in place.

steps.title: Preserve settings, cards and optional device choices
steps.instruction: Keep settings.toml, game.toml/game_options.toml, saves/ with both memory-card slots and their configured external paths, mods/ and its state, captures and original CUE/BIN. Source memory-card paths can override the default saves folder; preserve the actual configuration and all prior CWD roots. Card files are distinct from runtime save states. The mouse/controller GunCon emulation is an upstream software feature, not observed physical lightgun or two-player qualification. Online track/TOC identity gates and peers remain separate, untested requirements.

steps.title: Keep rights and maintenance explicit
steps.instruction: Retain PSXRecomp PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, exact recomp-ui MIT, OpenBIOS and SDL/ImGui/component notices; they do not license the original Namco game, proprietary BIOS or third-party artwork/mods. Keep only a complete copy you are independently permitted to use. Quit normally before upstream replacement or card/data changes, preserve recovery copies and review/relink changed executable bytes. No native/installed, real-save, hardware, gameplay or Supported acceptance is asserted. Removing registration preserves external files; managed lifecycle operations remain unavailable.

warnings: Use the prepared 1.1.0 PlayStation player and complete USA CUE/BIN. Preserve actual memory-card paths; arcade and physical-lightgun acceptance remain separate.
